renderings.kjv: or for any manner of lost thing

elsewhere.note: For every matter of trespass, whether it is for ox, for donkey, for sheep, for clothing, or for any kind of lost thing, about which one says, ‘This is mine,’…
or has found that which was lost, and lied about it, and swearing to a lie—in any of these things that a man sins in his actions—
So you shall do with his donkey. So you shall do with his garment. So you shall do with every lost thing of your brother’s, which he has lost and you have…
